page.overview:
Who is Wayne?

Wayne is a Twinborn on Scadrial; a Slider and a Bloodmaker. thumb He is a friend and colleague of Waxillium Ladrian. He lived in the Roughs and worked with Wax to keep law and order.

He traveled to Elendel to help investigate the Vanishers and attempted to convince Wax to return to the Roughs as a lawman. Wayne is of average height, lean and muscular, with a round, sharp-chinned face. At the time of the hunt for the Vanishers he was about 30 years old.

He prefers to dress in Roughs clothing with a duster coat. He has an affinity for hats, which he says are essential to completing his elaborate disguises. He cannot grow a "proper" beard.

He has an easygoing personality and is often seen manipulating his accent and style of speech depending on who he is with. He and Wax often exchange witty banter when together.
